snippet.title: FEED IT | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
FEED IT is a first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Explore your maze-like, rotting apartment and face a constant choice: do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready to deal with the consequences.

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370990/FEED_IT/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
